services.desc: What do you get when you come to see a Mr. Majestyk’s 8-Track Revival show? You get “Grade A” performances of rock and pop masterpieces from the 1970s. That’s right kids…this means tunes that you may not often hear these days. From ELO, Alice Cooper and Led Zeppelin, to rarities by Nick Gilder, Gary Wright and Sweet…MM8TR delivers 100% top fuel analog rock and roll, with a side of AM gold pop. Formed in 2013, Mr. Majestyk’s 8-Track Revival (and his Cavalcade of All-Stars) has established themselves as one of Colorado’s premiere live acts.
